data.name: Debananda
data.gender_notes: Debananda is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Debananda is a Sanskrit name derived from two words - ‘Deba’ meaning God and ‘Ananda’ meaning delight or pleasure. This name symbolizes the immense joy and happiness one experiences when in the presence of God. The name Debananda carries the meaning “God's Delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Debananda usually hope their child will grow to embody god's delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Living in constant bliss and devotion towards the divine.
data.etymology: Debananda belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Debananda total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
